name: Historic Centre of Sighişoara
description: Perched on a hill in Transylvania, Romania, Sighișoara is a medieval citadel that people still live in. Transylvanian Saxon craftsmen and merchants founded it in the 12th century, and its fortified walls and old streets have survived for some 850 years. It is also the birthplace of Vlad the Impaler, and each year a lively medieval festival fills its lanes.
